title: Tighten RBAC v2 policies, add audit-forwarding and KMS envelope support, and region pinning controls
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Security: Harden RBAC v2 default role mappings; Compliance: export audit logs to customer-configured SIEM; Platform: optional KMS envelope encryption for customer keys; Ops: add region pinning policy support for data residency
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated industries asked for stronger, auditable RBAC primitives after the recent compliance review (linked ENG-8423). This PR delivers three coordinated changes: 1) RBAC v2 policy tightening and a migration tool that preserves existing role bindings while enforcing least privilege; 2) audit-forwarding hooks and structured audit entries to support SIEM ingestion; 3) KMS envelope encryption support for customer-managed keys and region pinning controls so workloads can be constrained to approved regions.

Summary of changes (single-line list): migration script, rbac policy schema bump, audit formatter + forwarder, kms envelope adapter, routing middleware region-pin flag, tests and docs.

Checklist (worked through in commits): 
- [x] RBAC v2 schema bump and validator (schema_v2.json + validation code)
- [x] Migration tool: rbac/migrate_v1_to_v2.go with dry-run and apply modes
- [x] Audit: emit structured audit events for role/grant/revoke actions and request routing; add forwarder plugin that posts to configured HTTP endpoint (with backoff/retry)
- [x] KMS: kms/envelope_adapter.go implementing envelope encrypt/decrypt using AWS KMS and generic KMS interface for GCP/Azure future plumb
- [x] Region pinning: route layer checks cluster/region tags and rejects/rewrites requests per tenant policy; admin console toggle + API flag
- [x] Integration tests: rbac e2e (happy/failure paths), audit forwarder unit tests, kms adapter unit test with KMS mock, region pin policy functional tests
- [x] Docs: security/rbac_v2.md, ops/kms_integration.md, compliance/region_pinning.md

Commits (high level):
- a1b2c3: rbac: add v2 schema and validator (includes policy examples and commentary)
- d4e5f6: tooling: rbac migration CLI and dry-run support
- 7a8b9c: audit: structured event format and forwarder plugin (http/backoff)
- 0f1e2d: kms: envelope adapter skeleton + tests + docs
- 3c4b5a: routing: region pin enforcement and admin-api flag
- 6d7e8f: tests/docs: add e2e tests and example configuration for SOC customers

Files changed (high-level):
- rbac/schema_v2.json
- cmd/rbac-migrate/main.go
- internal/rbac/validator.go
- internal/audit/formatter.go
- internal/audit/forwarder/http_forwarder.go
- internal/kms/envelope_adapter.go
- internal/router/region_pin.go
- docs/security/rbac_v2.md
- docs/ops/kms_integration.md
- docs/compliance/region_pinning.md
- test/integration/rbac_e2e_test.go
- test/unit/kms_adapter_test.go

Notable implementation details: 
- RBAC v2 introduces role constraints and condition expressions (small DSL). Validator rejects grants that would expand privileges beyond existing bindings in dry-run migration mode; migration logs explicit transform steps to help audits.
- Audit entries are JSON objects with fields: timestamp, actor_id, tenant_id, action, target_type, target_id, before, after, request_id, region_hint. Forwarder supports HMAC-signed payloads if customer provides a secret.
- KMS envelope implementation follows the envelope pattern: generate data key locally, encrypt payload with AES-GCM, and encrypt data key with customer KMS key. Adapter supports AWS KMS GenerateDataKey and Encrypt/Decrypt; generic interface allows other providers. Key use is optional per-tenant; when enabled, encrypted blobs are stored in object storage with metadata describing the wrapping key ARN and region.
- Region pinning is enforced at the routing middleware: requests carry tenant metadata (tenant.region_policy). If tenant policy specifies allowed regions, requests routed to incompatible region are rejected with 403 and a structured audit event. Admins can override with an emergency bypass flag (requires separate audit log entry).

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- Default behavior remains unchanged until migration tool is run. We intentionally ship validator + migration in a single PR so SRE and security can coordinate rollout. Customers on Dedicated/Private will need to run the migration binary against their control plane database.
- KMS envelope is opt-in. Existing server-side encryption remains available.

CI and testing: CI initially failed due to linting around the DSL parser; fixed in second commit. All unit and integration tests pass in CI (see checks below). The audit-forwarder added a flaky test around HTTP retries that required increasing the backoff window; that fix is included.

Operational runbook (short):
1) Run rbac-migrate --dry-run and review generated transform log.
2) When ready, run rbac-migrate --apply during maintenance window.
3) If using KMS envelope, configure tenant KMS ARN and verify KMS IAM access from control plane.
4) To enforce region pinning, set tenant.region_policy in admin console and monitor audit events.

Reasonable follow-ups (future PRs): automated policy suggestions from usage telemetry, GCP KMS adapter, and per-tenant SIEM batching sink.
